# SDK shared-memory layout fixtures

Committed reference snapshots of the two official Afterburner SDK shared-memory layouts
(design § SDK layout fixtures & layout-generation script; plan task 18.3):

| File | Source header | Records |
|---|---|---|
| `mahm_layout.json` | `SDK\Include\MAHMSharedMemory.h` (monitoring, read-only) | `MAHM_SHARED_MEMORY_HEADER` (32 B), `MAHM_SHARED_MEMORY_ENTRY` (1324 B), `MAHM_SHARED_MEMORY_GPU_ENTRY` (1304 B) + the `MONITORING_SOURCE_ID_*` / entry-flag constants |
| `macm_layout.json` | `SDK\Include\MACMSharedMemory.h` (control) | `MACM_SHARED_MEMORY_HEADER` (36 B), `MACM_SHARED_MEMORY_GPU_ENTRY` (3760 B) incl. nested `MACM_SHARED_MEMORY_VF_CURVE` (3224 B) and its `VF_POINT_ENTRY` (12 B) / `POWER_TUPLE_ENTRY` (16 B) / `THERMAL_TUPLE_ENTRY` (16 B) children + `MACM_SHARED_MEMORY_COMMAND_*`, flag, and VF-curve bound constants |

## Provenance

- Generated by `tools/generate_sdk_layout_fixtures.py --generate` from the **real installed
  header bytes** on this machine — MSI Afterburner **4.6.7.17439** at
  `C:\Program Files (x86)\MSI Afterburner\SDK\Include\`.
- Each fixture records `from.header_sha256` = SHA-256 over the exact installed header bytes,
  so provenance is auditable and per-release re-verification (`--diff`) compares numerically
  against the committed values.
- Verified `--diff` clean (exit 0) against the live install immediately after generation.

## Consumers

- `tests/test_sdk_layout_consistency.py` (plan 18.3, CI, no install needed) loads both
  fixtures through the strict loader (`afterburner/integration/sdk_layout.py`) and replays
  the layout rules from the recorded field declarations — corrupted/truncated/hand-edited
  fixtures fail before the binding checks run.
- The ctypes binding checks (plan 18.4 monitoring / 20.3 control) compare the runtime
  `ctypes.Structure` definitions against these fixtures when no install is present, and
  against the live installed header (via `tools/generate_sdk_layout_fixtures.py --diff`)
  when one is.

## Regenerating

Only ever regenerate from a real install (the generator refuses `--generate` without one):

```text
python tools/generate_sdk_layout_fixtures.py --generate --install-dir "<MSI Afterburner dir>"
python tools/generate_sdk_layout_fixtures.py --diff    # CI drift gate
```

After an Afterburner update that changes a layout: re-run `--generate`, review and commit the
new fixtures, re-run the binding checks (18.4 / 20.3), and re-validate on real hardware
(per-release re-verification). Never hand-edit a fixture.
